title: jumellea lignosa var. ferkoana

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been reported to exhibit various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Jumellea lignosa var. ferkoana include its ability to protect against cell damage, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
